display_information.description: Gas City agent identity app — the mentionable Slack identity and outbound sender for one named company agent.
display_information.long_description: One agent identity app is provisioned per named company agent. Its bot user is the agent's real, mentionable <@U…> identity in company rooms and its bot token is the agent's outbound sending identity for gc slack delegate / reply-current. In the rooms phases it observes nothing — no event subscriptions — so the switchboard app stays the single admission owner for room traffic. The App Home Messages tab is enabled ahead of the per-agent DM phase, which later adds message.im + im:history. This app is internal to one visibility boundary and is never distributed on the Slack Marketplace. See https://github.com/gastownhall/gascity/tree/main/examples/slack-pack for setup.
